label.purpose: Controls, filters, and compact state text.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strongest action in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #496B67; color: #FDFBF7; font: 600 14px/1.3 "Segoe UI", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3C5D59; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2E6F9A; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Library search with a familiar, quiet field treatment.
components.css: .ds-search { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #252722; font: 600 14px/1.3 "Segoe UI", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input { min-height: 48px; padding: 11px 14px; border: 1px solid #D8D8CF; border-radius: 10px; background: #FDFBF7; color: #252722; font: 400 16px/1.5 "Segoe UI", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2E6F9A; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Selected Filter
components.description: A selected library filter with text and tonal state.
components.css: .ds-filter { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #DCE8E4; color: #252722; font: 600 14px/1.3 "Segoe UI", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-filter:hover { background: #CBDDD8; } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2E6F9A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Book Tile
components.description: A cover-led library target without a surrounding card.
components.css: .ds-book { display: grid; gap: 8px; width: 156px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #252722; text-align: left; font-family: "Segoe UI", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cover { display: block; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; border-radius: 6px; background: #496B67; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(37, 39, 34, 0.12); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-book strong { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-book small { color: #666A61; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-book:hover .ds-cover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-book:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2E6F9A; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 8px; }

narrative.overview: The interface feels like returning to a familiar shelf: warm enough for long reading sessions, orderly enough to scan without effort, and quiet enough that book covers provide most of the color.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral surfaces with one low-chroma sage-blue accent.
Shallow Library, Reading, and Settings information architecture.
Controls are familiar, explicit, and comfortably sized.
Motion is limited to state feedback between 150ms and 220ms.

rules.name: The Cover Color Rule
rules.body: The interface accent occupies no more than ten percent of a library screen. Book covers carry the visual variety.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: Offline, syncing, warning, deletion, and highlight meaning are never communicated by color alone.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Persistent application surfaces never rely on shadows to explain hierarchy.

dos: Do open directly to a recognizable cover library.
Do keep touch targets at least 48dp and show visible keyboard focus.
Do state whether removal affects this device, the cloud file, or the whole library.
donts: Don't recreate KOReader's file-browser-first launch experience, plugin surface, or dense specialist menus.
Don't expose cloud folders, upload queues, or manual push/pull behavior as the primary model.
Don't use glassmorphism, gradients, heavy shadows, neon accents, or decorative motion.
